_comment: Judgement calls: where neither a creature's level nor its danger score (see [Threat] in AdventurersGuild.ini) ranks it right. Keyed by race editor ID; tools/EspGen resolves them into threat.resolved.json, which is the file the game reads and the one to edit in an install. atLeast: never ranked below this. fromLevel: atLeast only applies from this level up (one race, several tiers). atMost: never ranked above this. Rank letters E D C B A S.

GiantRace._why: never a pushover, whatever level another mod gives it

DraugrRace._why: level 30 and up are the Deathlords: ebony weapons and shouts that their level (rank C) does not show. Draugr fight with carried weapons, so the danger score cannot lift them

DragonPriestRace._why: level 50 (rank A), a caster, so no danger score: the top of the draugr crypts

DLC2NetchRace._why: a lot of health and a real shock, but docile

HorseRace._why: its health alone would score D
